question: Dominic Thiem won the 2020 US Open Men's Single title by defeating _________ in the final.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Alexander Zverev**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Dominic Theme won the men's singles title of US Open 2020.
 
• Dominic Thiem won the men’s singles title at the 2020 US Open in New York, beating Alexander Zverev in Sunday’s epic final.
 
• He became the second Austrian national to win a Grand Slam.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• US Open__

 
 
• U.S. Open, formally the United States Open Tennis Championships, international tennis tournament, the fourth and final of the major events that make up the annual Grand Slam of tennis (the other three tournaments are the Australian Open, the French Open, and the Wimbledon Championships).
 
• The U.S. Open is held each year over a two-week period in late August and early September.
 
• Since 1978 all the U.S. Open championships have been played on the acrylic hard courts of the U.S. Tennis Associatio in Flushing Meadows, Queens, N.Y.
 
• The U.S. Open consists of championships in five main categories: men’s singles and doubles, women’s singles and doubles, and mixed doubles.
